_note: The studio's own games and design intentions, written from the project history. Used by the AI so it knows what you already built and what you want.

games.name: Convenience Store
games.about: GB game; minigames to improve: Viper Bros like a Mario game, Pillman like Pac-Man, Last Dream like Final Fantasy. Convenience Store 64: 3D N64 version, same story, GTA-style explorable world, day/night clock, NPCs from the other games.

games.name: Moonlight Holler / Super Moonlight Holler
games.about: GB farm game with guinea pigs, a windmill and the Dirt Road Brawler minigame. Super version for SNES: Stardew/Harvest Moon style farm, 2-player co-op, a DS port idea with a touch map and drag-and-drop inventory with a trash can.

games.name: Hounds Reloaded
games.about: SNES game with fake-3D missions; the favourite. Needs steady sprite/object movement and aiming.

games.name: Goodwill
games.about: Free demo. Job interview, then a job at a Goodwill in a real strip plaza (Binmart, daycare, flea market, buffet, Papa John's).

games.name: ICW: International Champions Wrestling Indie Promotion
games.about: DS wrestling game tying all the games into one universe. Roster: Rebecca, Steve, Austin, Dr. Vane, Squid, Joe, Michelle; managers Cliff and the store thief; Python is an original Houston heel. Skating data comes from the DS Tony Hawk games.

games.name: No One Can Stop Mr. Domino 2
games.about: PS1 sequel plan: 6 new levels, new opening animation, a new playable domino character.

games.name: Berea: After the Fall
games.about: DS post-apocalyptic RPG set in Berea, Kentucky.

games.name: Friendship Bracelets
games.about: DS jewelry-making life sim (3D life sim in the handoff doc); minigames can live inside it.

games.name: Coloring book
games.about: DS touch coloring book: cute floral designs and animals (guinea pigs, rabbits, cats, ferrets, turtles, frogs).

cast_looks.Steve: mohawk with long back; farmer who wrestles
cast_looks.Austin: long curly black hair often in a top bun, thin mustache, glasses, Quick Mart uniform or grey denim jacket

cast_looks.Joe: pale, skinny, goatee, long black hair, skateboards, plays arcades

rules: Every game starts with the NOTAREAL logo screen.
Games must run on the RG DS Plus (stock OS and GammaOS); N64 games are tested in ParaLLEl N64.
Faces should look realistic and detailed, not blocky.
CPU rivals are limited to 3 with preset skill levels.
Use the ROM library for the best tools and references so games feel real.
Wrestling titles (WWE/TNA) are the reference for character body movement; Super Mario 64 is the reference for 3D open-world movement; DS Tony Hawk for skating.
Every game type that can be 3D on the DS should be a real 3D engine with editable levels, characters, rules and moves.
The kit is for people who do not code; PC builds are controller-based and portable to Xbox.
